gate_reason: REQ-QA-001 through 005 are closed at 34655a4. The worktree HEAD ref resolves to that commit. This was a static recheck of the five carried-forward findings only. I did not run any tests or commands, so a green `just test` is not confirmed here. I also did not build a full requirement_checks list. The non-compliance below is not a finding because it is documented in the sprint doc and in the code; the scrum-master can decide whether it needs a ruling. The sweep in FileSessionStore::new (crates/sc-jev-check/src/session/mod.rs:151) uses 2x DEFAULT_SESSION_TTL, not the same cutoff as is_expired that the QA-1 fix text asked for. The deviation is stated at sprint-r-6-session-log-record.md:526-531. The reason given is that a zero-grace sweep would make SESSION_EXPIRED unreachable from the CLI. It is covered by test_new_store_sweeps_expired_session_documents (tests/session.rs:110). One more difference from the fix text: crates/sc-jev-host/tests/obs.rs does not assert response.warnings(). The tests at lines 114 and 150 use the adapter directly and have no response, and they already panic on a flush error.
